audit_metadata.title: SeedIQ Client Claim Verification & Complete Model Training Audit
audit_metadata.scope: Verify client-reported figures against existing repository evidence only. No new experiments, package installs, data fetches, or production changes.

crop_classification_rf.comparison_to_client_claim: verified number is 99.32%, client claimed 92%; no 92% measurement exists in registry

yield_xgb.algorithm: Gradient Boosting Regressor (XGBoost unavailable on host; HistGradientBoosting used)
yield_xgb.evaluation_method: grouped (District, Year) train/test split; held-out test; target Yield_Tonnes via LogPerHaRegressor (per-hectare via exp(pred)*area)
yield_xgb.comparison_to_client_claim: verified R2 ~0.90, client claimed 94% R2 / 0.95; MSE 0.05 and RMSE 0.22 not found anywhere

yield_f3_improved_dataset_track.baseline_model: F3 (0.8*HistGBR(base) + 0.2*HistGBR(base+dynamic-rainfall), per crop; Chickpea RF specialist)
yield_f3_improved_dataset_track.evaluation_method: GroupKFold(5) OOF on (District, Year) + frozen holdout via GroupShuffleSplit(0.2, random_state=42); grouped by District|Year
yield_f3_improved_dataset_track.comparison_to_client_claim: different metric (tolerance rate on t/ha, not R2 on total tonnes) and different dataset; not comparable to client R2 0.95 / MSE 0.05 / RMSE 0.22

seed_viability_improvement_real_labels.task: seed viability classification, 3-class, real labels (UCI Seeds wheat kernel measurements)
seed_viability_improvement_real_labels.label_source: UCI Seeds dataset (real wheat kernel measurements; NOT synthetic)
seed_viability_improvement_real_labels.outlier_filtering_bug_note: legacy clean_dataset() applied 1%-99% mask column-by-column with index shrinkage, dropping 29 rows (210->181) on older paths including legacy train_final_meta_and_compare.py; corrected experiment uses all 210 rows (UCI Seeds is already clean); the 42-row holdout numbers above are from the corrected pipeline and are internally consistent
seed_viability_improvement_real_labels.production_relevance_note: this is 3-class real-label seed viability; it is NOT the registry 'svm_model.pkl' seed entry (2-class, 100 synthetic records, 85%)
seed_viability_improvement_real_labels.comparison_to_client_claim: does not map to client SVM 89%; this is the strongest real-label seed result in the repo

meta_model_production_artifact_inspected.input_construct_note: 6-element vector built at request time in POST /api/quantum-ml from base models' normalized predictions; not a fixed dataset row
meta_model_production_artifact_inspected.output_semantics: binary 0/1 -> prob_success %; decision = Optimal vs Suboptimal Performance
meta_model_production_artifact_inspected.label_source: constructed / rule-derived binary success label; no independent ground-truth outcome observed in repository

global_meta_model_pkl_saved.note: so the global meta_model.pkl written by this script is a StackingClassifier from the seed task branch, which is a DIFFERENT object from the production RandomForestClassifier

meta_model_registry_entries.dataset_provenance: Stacked OOF/TEST predictions from base models trained on: crop=provided, yield=provided (ICRISAT), seed=synthetic-generated

app_previous_hardcoded_claim.app acknowledgement: SeedIQ/app.py line 922 acknowledges the app previously fell back to hardcoded percentages (rf 92% / xgb 94% / svm 89% / meta 96%) and now uses registry-fed metrics

model_by_model_comparison.our_verified_result: 99.32% test accuracy, 99.35% macro-precision, 99.32% macro-recall (22 classes, 2,200 records); older 5-crop production RF is a different artifact
model_by_model_comparison.evaluation_dataset_and_sample_count: Crop_recommendation.csv-based task, 2,200 records, 22 classes (registry); older 5-crop production RF trained on soil/weather schema with 5 classes

model_by_model_comparison.our_verified_result: R2 0.9035 test, CV R2 0.9111 (5,585 ICRISAT records, 23 features)
model_by_model_comparison.evaluation_method: grouped (District, Year) train/test split; held-out test; target Yield_Tonnes via LogPerHaRegressor

model_by_model_comparison.our_verified_result: 85% test accuracy, 84.52% macro-precision, 81.87% macro-recall (2-class, 100 synthetic records); plus real-label 3-class seed viability GBM 92.86% (39/42) from separate experiment
model_by_model_comparison.evaluation_dataset_and_sample_count: registry SVM seed: 100 records, 2 classes, synthetic-generated; real-seed experiment: Seed_Data.csv, 210 rows, 3 classes, UCI Seeds
model_by_model_comparison.evaluation_method: 80/20 stratified + 5-fold CV (registry); stratified 80/20 rs=42, one 42-row holdout, leakage-checked (real-seed experiment)
model_by_model_comparison.status: VERIFIED — registry SVM is 85% on synthetic 2-class; real-label 3-class seed viability is 92.86% (GBM), not an SVM

model_by_model_comparison.our_verified_result: production artifact is RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=3, min_samples_leaf=5, 6 features, binary) with constructed success label; training script builds StackingClassifier (different object); registry best test accuracy 58.64%, CV 57.44%
model_by_model_comparison.evaluation_dataset_and_sample_count: meta label built at request time from base-model outputs; seed leg synthetic-generated; no independent ground-truth outcome in repository
model_by_model_comparison.evaluation_method: per-request inference for production RF; 80/20 test + 5-fold CV for stacking model; no standalone real-outcome test set for the success label
model_by_model_comparison.status: UNREPRODUCIBLE — no 96% measurement exists; production model and training-script model mismatch; label is synthetic/rule-derived

model_by_model_comparison.our_verified_result: crop RF 99.32% acc/prec/recall (22-class); seed viability GBM 92.86% acc, macro-F1 0.9263 (3-class real); SVM seed 85% (2-class synthetic) — no single model produces 92/91/90/91
model_by_model_comparison.status: UNVERIFIED — no single model/task produces that exact aggregate

model_by_model_comparison.status: NOT VERIFIED — no matching measurement in repository

discrepancies_and_risks.description: Production meta_model.pkl is a plain RandomForestClassifier; train_final_meta_and_compare.py builds a StackingClassifier/StackingRegressor. They are different objects, feature spaces, and training data.
evidence: SeedIQ/models/meta_model.pkl inspected: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=3, min_samples_leaf=5, n_features_in_=6, classes=[0,1])
SeedIQ/train_final_meta_and_compare.py lines 315-317 save global meta_model.pkl only from the seed branch
SeedIQ/app.py line 3017 loads meta_model.pkl; lines 3105-3117 use it for prob_success

discrepancies_and_risks.description: The meta model predicts a constructed 'Optimal vs Suboptimal Performance' label from base-model outputs and a 50% threshold; the seed leg is synthetic-generated per the registry. There is no independent ground-truth outcome, so a 96% accuracy figure cannot be established as real-world performance.
evidence: SeedIQ/app.py lines 3105-3117 build prob_success from base-model predictions and threshold at 50%
SeedIQ/models/meta_model.pkl is a 6-feature binary RF with no stored feature names and no associated real-outcome test set

discrepancies_and_risks.description: The app previously surfaced hardcoded RF 92% / XGB 94% / SVM 89% / meta 96% as if measured; app.py line 922 acknowledges this fallback was replaced with registry-fed metrics. The registry does not contain these numbers.
evidence: SeedIQ/app.py line 922: 'fell back to hardcoded percentages (rf 92% / xgb 94% / svm 89% / meta 96%)'
SeedIQ/training_registry.json: latest entries show crop RF 99.32%, yield XGB R2 0.9035, SVM seed 85%, meta 58.64%

discrepancies_and_risks.description: Two yield lineages coexist: (a) live app stack yield model on yield_icrisat_karnataka.csv (R2 0.9035 test, 23 features, grouped split, total tonnes target); (b) improved-dataset F3 on enriched_yield_karnataka.csv (68.20% within +/-25% holdout, 1,088 rows, per-hectare target). Different datasets, targets, features, and metrics; not interchangeable.
evidence: SeedIQ/training_registry.json xgb_model.pkl: 5,585 records, 23 features, test_r2 0.903461, dataset_provenance ICRISAT
experiments/improved_dataset/phase12/results/phase12_results.json: 1,088 holdout rows, 68.1985% within +/-25%, r2 0.958949, target yield_per_hectare

discrepancies_and_risks.description: The registry SVM seed entry is a 2-class model on 100 synthetic records (85%). It is not the real-label 3-class seed viability task (210 rows, UCI Seeds), which is evaluated only in the meta_model_improvement experiment.
evidence: SeedIQ/training_registry.json svm_model.pkl latest: records=100, classes=2, dataset_provenance=synthetic-generated, test_accuracy=0.85
experiments/meta_model_improvement/metrics.json: 210 rows, 3 classes, real UCI Seeds labels, GBM 92.86%

discrepancies_and_risks.description: Legacy clean_dataset() applied a 1%-99% mask column-by-column with index shrinkage, dropping 29 rows (210->181) and producing non-reproducible splits on older paths including train_final_meta_and_compare.py. The corrected meta_model_improvement experiment uses all 210 rows and is internally consistent.
No independently observed 'overall success' outcome exists in the repository for the meta model's binary label, so its real-world accuracy cannot be established; the 96% claim is unsubstantiated.
evidence: SeedIQ/models/meta_model.pkl: binary RF, constructed label, no real-outcome test set
SeedIQ/training_registry.json: no entry with test_accuracy near 0.96; best is 0.586364
SeedIQ/app.py: prob_success derived from base-model outputs

meta_model_96pct_verdict.reason: no 96% measurement exists in repository; production artifact is a synthetic-label 6-feature binary RF; training script builds a different StackingClassifier; registry best meta accuracy is 58.64%
meta_model_96pct_verdict.label_source: constructed heuristic success label; seed leg synthetic-generated; no independent ground-truth outcome

highest_priority_next_action.primary: Fix the Meta Model's evidentiary basis before claiming any accuracy for it: either (1) define and collect a real 'overall success' outcome and retrain/evaluate the meta model against it, or (2) stop presenting prob_success as a measured 96% accuracy and relabel it explicitly as a heuristic confidence score with the synthetic seed leg disclosed.
secondary: Reconcile the train-serve mismatch: make production meta_model.pkl be the model actually trained/evaluated, or document why they legitimately differ.
Align dashboard/narrative with actual measured numbers (crop 99.32%, yield R2 0.9035 / F3 68.20% +/-25%, seed viability 92.86%) instead of legacy 92/94/89/96% placeholders.
If the client's yield figures (MSE 0.05 / RMSE 0.22 / R2 0.95) come from a specific script/dataset/split, obtain that exact evaluation for apples-to-apples comparison.
